routine: 단어 5분(예문 소리 내어 2번) → 패턴 5분(뼈대에 내 문장 넣기) → 위를 가리고 문제 3분 → 복습 2분 → 오늘 쓸 표현 1개 골라 실제 메일에 쓰기

review.title: 복습 (11/12 표현 + 오답 2개), 영어로 먼저 써 보기

items.answer: Could you let me know where ~ stands?
What would you suggest (that) we do if ~?

items.prompt: (필요성·금액의) 타당한 이유를 대다 — explain why 대신

cover_practice.prompt: 뒤로 미루다: Can we d____ the payment until the repair is checked?
단계: The roof repair will be done in two p_____.
인정하다·확인해 주다: Please a__________ receipt of the signed contract.
추가의·보완하는: Please attach s____________ documents to the visa application.
이번 달 주문이 적으므로 토요일 잔업은 하지 않겠습니다. (주어·동사 넣기)
cover_practice.answer: Given that orders are low this month, we will not work overtime on Saturday.

cover_practice.prompt: 인보이스를 받을 때까지 가격이 오른 줄 몰랐습니다. (주어·동사 넣기)
cover_practice.answer: We were not aware that the price had gone up until we received the invoice.

words.meaning: (결정·구매를) 뒤로 미루다 — do later / not now 대신
words.example: SSD prices are high now, so we will defer the replacement until the drive fails.
words.collocations: defer the purchase / defer a decision

words.example: We will replace the CCTV hard disks in three phases to spread the cost.

words.meaning: (잘못·사실을) 인정하다, (받았음을) 확인해 주다 — accept / say OK 대신
words.example: The supplier acknowledged the mistake on the invoice and will issue it again.
The auditor asked us to send supplementary documents by Friday.

patterns.meaning: ~이므로(~을 감안해) ~하겠습니다 (~ is high, so we ~ 대신, 결정의 이유를 먼저 밝힐 때)
patterns.email: Given that the total cost is high, we will replace only five drives this year.
patterns.spoken: Since the total is high, we'll only replace five this year.

patterns.pattern: We were not aware that ~ until ~.
patterns.meaning: ~할 때까지 ~인 줄 몰랐습니다 (We didn't know 대신, 늦게 알게 된 경위를 설명할 때)
patterns.skeleton: We were not aware that + [주어][동사] + until + [주어][동사]
patterns.email: We were not aware that the forwarder had changed the price until we received the invoice.
patterns.spoken: We didn't know about the new price until the invoice came.

patterns.pattern: I would like to bring ~ to your attention.
patterns.meaning: ~을 알려(보고) 드립니다 (I want to tell you ~ 대신, 윗사람·본사에 문제를 처음 꺼낼 때)
patterns.skeleton: I would like to bring + [명사] + to your attention
patterns.email: I would like to bring a delay in the roof repair to your attention.
patterns.spoken: I just want to flag one thing: the roof repair is delayed.

source: 11/14 보낸 메일(전산 부품 교체 보류·단계 교체, 세무 행정 건 회신)과 회계팀 보고 메일에서 고름.
